source_plate.artist: Gustave Doré (1832-1883), engraver; text by Dante Alighieri
source_plate.license_verified: read from the Commons imageinfo extmetadata at acquisition, not asserted by the operator
source_plate.post_process: plate detected on the scanned page and extracted to 2954x3663 at (699,1148) of 4660x6248 (inset 0.01), then grayscale, brightness 0.62 / contrast 1.08 toward the void, longest edge <= 1600px, WebP q44
source_plate.artist_note: Commons' extmetadata names Dante (the book's author); the plate is Doré's Purgatorio, Canto I, from the 1871 German edition (Göttliche Komödie, T. 2, Das Fegefeuer).
source_plate.note: The title plate until 2026-11-04 (plan 121.2). Its graded WebP left the tree with it; the icons are cut from the Commons original by this record's crop.
